label: vision: a synthetic brief to real representation learning

brief.topic: visual representation learning: what training explains
workshop_hints: workshop scope: visual representation learning and efficient pretraining

cfp.text: Workshop on Learned Visual Representations. A synthetic call, invented for a fixture. A call for work on how visual representations are learned and on how much of their quality training explains. Topics of interest: visual representation learning, efficient pretraining, evaluation with linear probes, and evaluation practices. Submissions are limited to 9 pages. Papers are evaluated on novelty, significance, technical quality, and clarity.

selection.compute_constraint: One CPU core or one small GPU.
selection.data_constraint: A locally staged CIFAR-10 copy; no downloads at run time.
selection.experimental_constraint: Seeded, containerized where generated code runs live, torch and torchvision only.

admission.scheduling_requirement: Jobs run one at a time on one machine.
admission.job_duration_requirement: Individual jobs bounded to ten minutes.
admission.checkpoint_requirement: State-dict checkpoints as run artifacts; no mid-job resume at this size.

funding.authority: Lab operator: vision allocation for the first production chain.
